steps.title: Genesis
steps.lesson: Empty series. No oracle. Nothing is a dollar.

steps.title: Lock 0.5 tKAS
steps.lesson: Alice’s claim equals locked sompi. Parker’s receipt rule.

steps.title: Transfer to Bob
steps.lesson: Quantity and backing unchanged. Name is not authenticity.

steps.title: Redeem 0.2 tKAS
steps.lesson: Bob gets sompi. Sponsor pays the fee. No skim.

steps.title: Full redeem + skim refused
steps.lesson: Series empty. SKIM rejected. This can go on-chain as successor A.
